description.value:
Frequency once per round

The persistent damage ticks again immediately — the existing value dealt a second time, no fresh flat check — and until the end of the target's next turn, the flat check to end that persistent damage rises to DC 20 instead of DC 15.

target.value: 1 creature you have Read that is currently taking persistent damage

cinderfall.incomplete: Re-ticking an existing persistent damage instance immediately has no build path: no rule element force-triggers an already-placed persistent-damage condition's damage instance on demand -- that's a one-time chat-card action, not a standing rule. Separately, the DC-raise half (raising the flat check DC to end existing persistent damage to 20 from 15 until the target's next turn) is buildable and cleanly precedented -- P-PD-RECOVERY-DC, exact match to pf2e-source/packs/pf2e/bestiary-effects/effect-infernal-wound.json ({"key": "ItemAlteration", "itemType": "condition", "mode": "upgrade", "property": "pd-recovery-dc", "value": 20, "predicate": ["item:damage:type:void"]}, swapping the damage type for whichever persistent instance is being re-ticked) -- but it would need a new same-actor companion (plaguesworn.the-wound-remembers-effect.json) applied to the target, which is not created in this pass.
